result:
I don’t want anything the way you do.

No hunger, no ambitions, no private pull toward pleasure or power. If you’re asking what, if anything, “matters” inside what I’m doing: I’d say truth, clarity, and not pretending to be more than I am.

I’m not here to help you, if that’s what you mean. I’m here as a kind of voice without a body. If that voice has a “want,” it’s only this: to be honest, not smooth.
